mechanism: Both drugs can impair renal function through different mechanisms (metformin-associated lactic acidosis risk with renal decline; candesartan-induced reduction in glomerular filtration), creating potential for additive renal dysfunction and metformin accumulation.
action: Monitor renal function (eGFR/creatinine) regularly; consider metformin dose adjustment or discontinuation if eGFR falls below 30 mL/min/1.73m²; ensure adequate hydration and assess for lactic acidosis symptoms.
